beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: A clock shows the time with two hands. The long hand is the minute hand.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: It starts at the twelve, and each number it reaches is five more minutes: five, ten, fifteen, twenty.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: The short hand is the hour hand. Watch it while the long hand counts those twenty minutes again.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Twenty minutes is only part of an hour, so it moves only part of the way toward the three, the next number.

beats.speaker: learner
beats.say: So the last number it reached is the two, and the hour is two.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: We write the hour, then two dots called a colon, then the minutes: two twenty.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: What time does the clock show?

do.text: What time does the clock show?

beats.speaker: learner
beats.say: The short hand is almost on the ten. I say ten fifty.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Start again at nine o'clock, and count: five, ten, fifteen, twenty, twenty-five, thirty, thirty-five, forty, forty-five, fifty.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Fifty minutes is most of the hour, so the short hand has gone most of the way from the nine toward the ten. It has not reached the ten.

beats.speaker: learner
beats.say: The last number it reached is the nine. Nine fifty.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Priya eats dinner at the time on the clock. Which time is it?

do.text: Priya eats dinner at the time on the clock. Which time is it?

beats.speaker: learner
beats.say: The long hand is on the two: five, ten minutes. The short hand last reached the five. So it reads five ten.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Each clock time happens twice a day. Times from midnight to noon are called A.M. Times from noon to midnight are called P.M.

beats.speaker: learner
beats.say: Dinner is in the evening, after noon. So it is five ten P.M.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: In one hour, the long hand goes all the way round, and the short hand moves on to the next number.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Minutes: count by fives from the twelve. Hour: the last number the short hand has reached.
